2487: function uepComparableDate(value,basis=attendanceViewDate||dateKey(today)){
2488:   if(value==null||value==='')return '';
2489:   if(typeof value==='object')value=value.formattedValue||value.value||value.date||value.serial||'';
2490:   const text=String(value).trim();
2491:   // __UEP_08160_ISO_CALENDAR_DATE__
2492:   if(/^20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}T.*(?:Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})$/i.test(text)){
2493:     const instant=new Date(text);
2494:     if(!Number.isNaN(instant.getTime())){
2495:       const parts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Asia/Seoul',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).formatToParts(instant);
2496:       const p=Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part=>[part.type,part.value]));
2497:       if(p.year&&p.month&&p.day)return p.year+'-'+p.month+'-'+p.day;
2498:     }
2499:   }

2503:   }
2504:   const full=text.match(/(20\d{2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})/);
2505:   if(full)return `${full[1]}-${full[2].padStart(2,'0')}-${full[3].padStart(2,'0')}`;
2506:   const compact=text.replace(/\D/g,'');
2507:   if(/^20\d{6}$/.test(compact))return compact.slice(0,4)+'-'+compact.slice(4,6)+'-'+compact.slice(6,8);
2508:   const monthDay=text.match(/(?:^|\D)(\d{1,2})\s*(?:월|[.\-/])\s*(\d{1,2})(?:\s*일)?(?:\D|$)/);
2509:   if(monthDay){const year=String(basis||dateKey(today)).slice(0,4)||'2026';return year+'-'+monthDay[1].padStart(2,'0')+'-'+monthDay[2].padStart(2,'0');}

2487: function uepComparableDate(value,basis=attendanceViewDate||dateKey(today)){
2488:   if(value==null||value==='')return '';
2489:   if(typeof value==='object')value=value.formattedValue||value.value||value.date||value.serial||'';

2493:     const instant=new Date(text);

2496:       const p=Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part=>[part.type,part.value]));
2497:       if(p.year&&p.month&&p.day)return p.year+'-'+p.month+'-'+p.day;

2503:   }

2487: function uepComparableDate(value,basis=attendanceViewDate||dateKey(today)){
2488:   if(value==null||value==='')return '';
2489:   if(typeof value==='object')value=value.formattedValue||value.value||value.date||value.serial||'';
2490:   const text=String(value).trim();
2491:   // __UEP_08160_ISO_CALENDAR_DATE__
2492:   if(/^20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}T.*(?:Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})$/i.test(text)){
2493:     const instant=new Date(text);
2494:     if(!Number.isNaN(instant.getTime())){
2495:       const parts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Asia/Seoul',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).formatToParts(instant);
2496:       const p=Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part=>[part.type,part.value]));
2497:       if(p.year&&p.month&&p.day)return p.year+'-'+p.month+'-'+p.day;
2498:     }
2499:   }
2500:   if(/^\d{5}(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(text)){
2501:     const serial=Number(text),utc=new Date(Math.round((serial-25569)*86400000));
2502:     if(!Number.isNaN(utc.getTime()))return `${utc.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(utc.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(utc.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
2503:   }
2504:   const full=text.match(/(20\d{2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})/);
2505:   if(full)return `${full[1]}-${full[2].padStart(2,'0')}-${full[3].padStart(2,'0')}`;
2506:   const compact=text.replace(/\D/g,'');
2507:   if(/^20\d{6}$/.test(compact))return compact.slice(0,4)+'-'+compact.slice(4,6)+'-'+compact.slice(6,8);
2508:   const monthDay=text.match(/(?:^|\D)(\d{1,2})\s*(?:월|[.\-/])\s*(\d{1,2})(?:\s*일)?(?:\D|$)/);
2509:   if(monthDay){const year=String(basis||dateKey(today)).slice(0,4)||'2026';return year+'-'+monthDay[1].padStart(2,'0')+'-'+monthDay[2].padStart(2,'0');}
2510:   const parsed=new Date(text);
2511:   if(!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()))return `${parsed.getFullYear()}-${String(parsed.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(parsed.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
2512:   return text.slice(0,10);
2513: }

2487: function uepComparableDate(value,basis=attendanceViewDate||dateKey(today)){
2488:   if(value==null||value==='')return '';
2489:   if(typeof value==='object')value=value.formattedValue||value.value||value.date||value.serial||'';
2490:   const text=String(value).trim();
2491:   // __UEP_08160_ISO_CALENDAR_DATE__
2492:   if(/^20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}T.*(?:Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})$/i.test(text)){
2493:     const instant=new Date(text);
2494:     if(!Number.isNaN(instant.getTime())){
2495:       const parts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Asia/Seoul',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).formatToParts(instant);
2496:       const p=Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part=>[part.type,part.value]));
2497:       if(p.year&&p.month&&p.day)return p.year+'-'+p.month+'-'+p.day;
2498:     }
2499:   }

2503:   }

2487: function uepComparableDate(value,basis=attendanceViewDate||dateKey(today)){
2488:   if(value==null||value==='')return '';
2489:   if(typeof value==='object')value=value.formattedValue||value.value||value.date||value.serial||'';
2490:   const text=String(value).trim();
2491:   // __UEP_08160_ISO_CALENDAR_DATE__
2492:   if(/^20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}T.*(?:Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})$/i.test(text)){
2493:     const instant=new Date(text);
2494:     if(!Number.isNaN(instant.getTime())){
2495:       const parts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Asia/Seoul',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).formatToParts(instant);
2496:       const p=Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part=>[part.type,part.value]));
2497:       if(p.year&&p.month&&p.day)return p.year+'-'+p.month+'-'+p.day;
2498:     }
2499:   }
2500:   if(/^\d{5}(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(text)){
2501:     const serial=Number(text),utc=new Date(Math.round((serial-25569)*86400000));
2502:     if(!Number.isNaN(utc.getTime()))return `${utc.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(utc.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(utc.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
2503:   }
2504:   const full=text.match(/(20\d{2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})/);
2505:   if(full)return `${full[1]}-${full[2].padStart(2,'0')}-${full[3].padStart(2,'0')}`;
2506:   const compact=text.replace(/\D/g,'');
2507:   if(/^20\d{6}$/.test(compact))return compact.slice(0,4)+'-'+compact.slice(4,6)+'-'+compact.slice(6,8);
2508:   const monthDay=text.match(/(?:^|\D)(\d{1,2})\s*(?:월|[.\-/])\s*(\d{1,2})(?:\s*일)?(?:\D|$)/);
2509:   if(monthDay){const year=String(basis||dateKey(today)).slice(0,4)||'2026';return year+'-'+monthDay[1].padStart(2,'0')+'-'+monthDay[2].padStart(2,'0');}
2510:   const parsed=new Date(text);
2511:   if(!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()))return `${parsed.getFullYear()}-${String(parsed.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(parsed.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
2512:   return text.slice(0,10);

2487: function uepComparableDate(value,basis=attendanceViewDate||dateKey(today)){
2488:   if(value==null||value==='')return '';
2489:   if(typeof value==='object')value=value.formattedValue||value.value||value.date||value.serial||'';
2490:   const text=String(value).trim();
2491:   // __UEP_08160_ISO_CALENDAR_DATE__
2492:   if(/^20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}T.*(?:Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})$/i.test(text)){
2493:     const instant=new Date(text);
2494:     if(!Number.isNaN(instant.getTime())){
2495:       const parts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Asia/Seoul',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).formatToParts(instant);
2496:       const p=Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part=>[part.type,part.value]));
2497:       if(p.year&&p.month&&p.day)return p.year+'-'+p.month+'-'+p.day;
2498:     }
2499:   }

2503:   }
2504:   const full=text.match(/(20\d{2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})/);
2505:   if(full)return `${full[1]}-${full[2].padStart(2,'0')}-${full[3].padStart(2,'0')}`;
2506:   const compact=text.replace(/\D/g,'');
2507:   if(/^20\d{6}$/.test(compact))return compact.slice(0,4)+'-'+compact.slice(4,6)+'-'+compact.slice(6,8);
2508:   const monthDay=text.match(/(?:^|\D)(\d{1,2})\s*(?:월|[.\-/])\s*(\d{1,2})(?:\s*일)?(?:\D|$)/);

2487: function uepComparableDate(value,basis=attendanceViewDate||dateKey(today)){
2488:   if(value==null||value==='')return '';
2489:   if(typeof value==='object')value=value.formattedValue||value.value||value.date||value.serial||'';
2490:   const text=String(value).trim();
2491:   // __UEP_08160_ISO_CALENDAR_DATE__
2492:   if(/^20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}T.*(?:Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})$/i.test(text)){
2493:     const instant=new Date(text);
2494:     if(!Number.isNaN(instant.getTime())){
2495:       const parts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Asia/Seoul',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).formatToParts(instant);
2496:       const p=Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part=>[part.type,part.value]));
2497:       if(p.year&&p.month&&p.day)return p.year+'-'+p.month+'-'+p.day;
2498:     }
2499:   }
2500:   if(/^\d{5}(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(text)){
2501:     const serial=Number(text),utc=new Date(Math.round((serial-25569)*86400000));
2502:     if(!Number.isNaN(utc.getTime()))return `${utc.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(utc.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(utc.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
2503:   }
2504:   const full=text.match(/(20\d{2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})/);
2505:   if(full)return `${full[1]}-${full[2].padStart(2,'0')}-${full[3].padStart(2,'0')}`;
2506:   const compact=text.replace(/\D/g,'');
2507:   if(/^20\d{6}$/.test(compact))return compact.slice(0,4)+'-'+compact.slice(4,6)+'-'+compact.slice(6,8);
2508:   const monthDay=text.match(/(?:^|\D)(\d{1,2})\s*(?:월|[.\-/])\s*(\d{1,2})(?:\s*일)?(?:\D|$)/);
2509:   if(monthDay){const year=String(basis||dateKey(today)).slice(0,4)||'2026';return year+'-'+monthDay[1].padStart(2,'0')+'-'+monthDay[2].padStart(2,'0');}
2510:   const parsed=new Date(text);
2511:   if(!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()))return `${parsed.getFullYear()}-${String(parsed.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(parsed.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
2512:   return text.slice(0,10);
2513: }

2487: function uepComparableDate(value,basis=attendanceViewDate||dateKey(today)){

2494:     if(!Number.isNaN(instant.getTime())){
2495:       const parts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Asia/Seoul',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).formatToParts(instant);
2496:       const p=Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part=>[part.type,part.value]));
2497:       if(p.year&&p.month&&p.day)return p.year+'-'+p.month+'-'+p.day;
2498:     }

7861: function recordGradeClass(row){
7862:   const studentNo=String(row?.studentNo||row?.number||row?.studentNumber||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
7863:   const grade=String(row?.grade||row?.gradeNo||row?.studentGrade||(studentNo.length>=4?studentNo[0]:'')||'');
7864:   let classNo=String(row?.classNo||row?.className||row?.class||'').replace(/[^0-9]/g,'');
7865:   if(!classNo&&studentNo.length>=4) classNo=String(Number(studentNo.slice(1,3))||'');
7866:   return {grade,classNo};
7867: }
7868: function filterRowsByCurrentTeacherScope(rows){
7869:   const scope=currentTeacherAccessScope();
7870:   if(!Array.isArray(rows))return [];
7871:   if(!scope.grade&&!scope.classNo)return rows.slice();
7872:   return rows.filter(row=>{
7873:     const gc=recordGradeClass(row);
7874:     if(scope.grade&&gc.grade&&gc.grade!==scope.grade)return false;
7875:     if(scope.classNo&&gc.classNo&&String(Number(gc.classNo))!==String(Number(scope.classNo)))return false;
7876:     return true;
7877:   });
7878: }

1140: function navigate(page) {
1141:   if(setupWizardActive){ renderSetupWizard(); return; }
1142:   // v0.78.7: hidden legacy pages are routed into their integrated hubs.

1145:   if(routedDuties){ workEmbeddedMode="duties"; page="work"; }
1146:   if(routedForms){ workEmbeddedMode="forms"; page="work"; }
1147:   if(page==="alerts"){ outputHubMode="alerts"; page="outputs"; }
1148:   if(page==="calendar" && state.activePage!=="calendar" && !routedTimetable) calendarHubMode="schedule";
1149:   if(page==="work" && state.activePage!=="work" && !routedDuties && !routedForms) workEmbeddedMode="home";
1150:   // 좌측 메뉴를 다시 누르거나 다른 메뉴로 이동하면 해당 모듈의 첫 화면부터 시작합니다.

1159:     recordQueryMode="student";
1160:     recordWriterArea="autonomy";
1161:     recordWriterSelected.clear();
1162:     recordSdgsDetail="";
1163:   }else if(page==="scores"){

1165:   }else if(page==="programs"){
1166:     programMode="home";
1167:     if(typeof programViewMode!=="undefined")programViewMode="list";

1173:   }else if(page==="timetable"){

1175:   }else if(page==="work"){
